content_html:
Peru is not only a destination for backpackers and adventurers; It also offers unique luxury experiences, with world-class hotels, high-end trains and unforgettable dining experiences. If you are looking to travel with comfort and exclusivity, here we present the best of luxury tourism in Peru.

1. Luxury hotels in Peru

Explore Sacred Valley

A luxury lodge surrounded by mountains, ideal for those seeking privacy and personalized experiences. Their packages include private excursions to archaeological sites and spa sessions with Andean ingredients.

Hotel Paracas, a Luxury Collection Resort (Paracas)

Located facing the ocean, this resort offers suites with stunning views, private access to yachts to explore the Ballestas Islands, and a spa with sea-inspired treatments.

Belmond Andean Explorer (Luxury Train, Cusco – Arequipa)

Considered the first luxury night train in South America, it offers a spectacular journey through the Andes with elegant cabins, an observatory car and gourmet dinners while passing through unparalleled landscapes.

2. Exclusive experiences in Peru

Private Pisco tasting at Hacienda Queirolo (Ica)

Enjoy an exclusive tasting at the only luxury winery-hotel in Peru. Here you can learn about pisco production, taste limited editions and tour the vineyards in private carriages.

Private yacht tour on Lake Titicaca

Discover the floating islands of Uros and Taquile Island aboard a luxury yacht. The experience includes gourmet lunch on board and a specialized guide for total immersion in the local culture.

Helicopter flight over Machu Picchu and the Sacred Valley

For a unique experience, some operators offer helicopter flights from Cusco, allowing you to see Machu Picchu from the air before landing for a private tour.

Dinner at “Mil” (Moray, Cusco) with Virgilio Martínez

This internationally renowned restaurant, run by Central's chef, offers a tasting menu based on high-altitude ingredients, providing an incomparable gastronomic experience with views of the Moray platforms.

3. Best time for a luxury trip to Peru

Ideal season: From May to September (dry weather and clear views).
Avoid February: Heavy rains and closure of the Inca Trail.
March is a good season due to all the traditional festivals and lower prices in hotels, restaurants and tours.
